style: Night set in Maya's room: moon and stars in the window, warm desk-lamp glow, everything else soft. Maya (amber captions, pencil bun) panics behind the desk and Floey (pink captions) stays dry on the laptop lid or hovering by Maya's head. One listInsert cutaway (beats 4 to 6), no notification. The running joke is Maya's cold coffee: the mug is set up in beat 2 and pays off in the silent button.

panels.subject: mayaTight, with only Maya in frame. Bad-tone '-5%' stat pill nudged to x 760, y 560 so it sits fully inside the frame. Sweat mark by her temple.
panels.action: Already mid-panic from frame one: panic face, 'type' pose, hands hammering the keys as she refreshes. A small panic shake settles by 0.6 s.

panels.subject: mayaTight, Maya alone. The '-5%' pill and the sweat mark are still up.
panels.action: On 'I'm putting the old one back' she turns worried and decisive: one firm nod and a hard final keystroke. Slow push-in. The '-5%' pill fades out by 3.3 s, before the cut.

panels.subject: floey two-shot: Floey perched on the laptop lid, facing Maya over the back of the laptop. Maya behind with the sweat mark still up.
panels.action: Floey tilts her head, then gives one dry chip on 'compared'. Maya freezes mid-type with her panic face held, and her eyes flick down to Floey.

panels.subject: wide: Maya behind the desk, Floey on the laptop lid, DUO.mug() on the desk by the laptop.
panels.action: Maya turns annoyed and jolts upright out of the 'type' pose (MY.jolt) on 'To before!', then gives a short pointL at Floey. Floey gives a slow smug nod, not impressed.

panels.subject: wide, slight push towards Maya and the mug
panels.action: On 'coffee' Maya's eyes drop to the mug (MY.look down right) and she lowers her arm to rest with a sad little pout. This plants the cold-coffee joke. Floey holds her deadpan.

panels.subject: floey two-shot, panning gently right to left as Floey moves to floeyHover by Maya's head
panels.action: Floey takes off from the lid with a wing whirr (panned right to left) and settles hovering at Maya's eye height.

panels.subject: floey two-shot: Floey hovering, Maya leaning in
panels.action: Maya leans towards the laptop (MY.leanTo), her face moving from annoyed to deadpan, and goes back into the 'type' pose. Floey chips once on 'same dates'.

panels.subject: maya: Maya alone, typing. Floey is out of frame.
panels.action: Deadpan 'Fine.' with brisk typing. On 'down...' her face turns worried and her typing slows.

panels.subject: listInsert (the reel's one cutaway). Title 'Same dates, compared', sub 'Search Console'.
panels.action: The insert swings in with a whoosh. On 'twenty' row one, 'Whole site' with '-20%' in red tone, slides in (rowsK). No second row yet, so nothing on the card is blank.

panels.subject: listInsert holds on the 'Whole site -20%' row. Floey's line plays in the pink caption.
panels.action: A slow push-in on the card as Floey asks 'And your page?'. Off screen, Floey flies back to her laptop-lid perch, ready for beat 7.

panels.subject: listInsert: 'Whole site -20%' (red) with the new row 'This page -5%' (amber) underneath
panels.action: On 'Five' row two slides in (rowsK). On 'Wait' the highlight ring grows round the page row (hiK, hi: true) with one ding.

panels.subject: mayaTight, Maya alone
panels.action: The insert whooshes out on a cut to Maya. Her surprised face blooms into happy on 'beat the site?'. She sits up out of the lean (MY.sit) and gives a small 'fist' pose.

panels.subject: floeyTight: Floey alone, back on the laptop lid. A good-tone '+15 pts' stat pill sits above her, fully inside the frame. It is the gap between the two example numbers on the card.
panels.action: The '+15 pts' pill pops in. Floey gives one slow, smug nod on 'fifteen points'.

panels.subject: floey two-shot: Floey on the lid, Maya pleased behind her, the mug on the desk. The '+15 pts' pill fades out at 0.
panels.action: Floey pivots to face the camera (F.pivot front) and delivers 'Save this for your next rewrite.' as the button line. Behind her, Maya turns happy and reaches for the mug. She switches to the 'mug' pose by 1.0 s, and from then DUO.mug() is no longer drawn.

panels.subject: wide: Maya holding the mug, Floey on the lid facing the camera
panels.action: Silent acting, with END pushed later to fit it. Maya, proud, takes a satisfied sip (soft sip cue). Floey holds her front-facing smug look.

panels.subject: mayaTight, Maya alone with the mug at her lips
panels.action: Cold coffee. Her face drops to annoyed, she lowers the mug a little and slumps (MY.slump).

panels.subject: mayaTight, Maya alone
panels.action: She goes deadpan and turns a slow look to the camera (MY.look 0, 0). A tiny push-in, held on the look.

panels.subject: End card: the Flowra logo intact, with Floey perched on the spark's left arm facing the camera. Line: 'Maya & Floey, every day'.
panels.action: The end card lands with a thump. Captions are hidden.
